hook.name: LaunchSatoHook
hook.description: A launchpad bonding-curve hook for the LaunchSato platform that routes all buys and sells through a custom exponential curve, minting tokens on buys and burning on sells. Buys require a swapper address in hookData, are capped per transaction, and are permanently closed once 99% of the fair token supply is minted; sells remain enabled with a 1-block cooldown after a buy.
